plugins.name: remote-access
plugins.description: Develop on embedded devices over SSH from Claude Code. Read, write, edit, glob, grep, and run bash on a remote host (e.g. armv7l Raspberry Pi) without installing Claude Code on the device.

plugins.name: amanuensis
plugins.description: A Claude Code plugin that helps authors draft and edit in their own voice — captures style, expands sketches into prose, and runs targeted review passes.

plugins.name: dude
plugins.description: Ultra-minimal RAG and cross-project memory. Persistent issues and specs with semantic vector search, auto-retrieve hooks, and auto-persist hooks.

plugins.name: micropython
plugins.description: A plugin to interact with micropython devices within Claude.

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: AWS services monitor for Claude Code. Monitor and interact with EC2, S3, Lambda, ECS, CloudWatch, and CloudFormation from your Claude session.

plugins.name: mozart
plugins.description: MIDI plugin for Claude Code. Load, analyze, edit, and compose MIDI files with musical intelligence — time-signature and tempo aware navigation, note search, transpose, quantize, and more.

plugins.name: tail
plugins.description: Run processes in the background and stream their logs back to Claude. Start, stop, restart, tail/filter output, and wait_for a pattern, idle, or exit — with whole-tree cleanup.

plugins.name: openscad
plugins.description: OpenSCAD parametric modeling — generate, edit, and visually inspect 3D models with Claude.

plugins.name: skidl
plugins.description: Design electronic schematics and PCB layouts using SKiDL — create circuits with Python code, validate designs, and export to KiCad.

plugins.name: build123d
plugins.description: CAD modeling with build123d — create, inspect, and export parametric 3D models using Python.

plugins.name: theology
plugins.description: Exegetical theology research — rigorous, multi-perspective Biblical exegesis with historian, linguist, author, theologian, disciple, shepherd, and full research skills.

plugins.name: spotify
plugins.description: Control Spotify playback on your devices — play, pause, skip, search, queue, volume, device transfer, recommendations, and more via the Spotify Web API.

plugins.name: song2html
plugins.description: Read, write, parse, validate, transpose, and render song chord charts — plain-text notation with lyrics, Nashville numbers, and arrangements.

plugins.name: terse
plugins.description: Ultra-compressed caveman-voiced communication mode. Cuts ~70% of output tokens — fragments, no filler, no pleasantries — while keeping full technical accuracy and production-quality deliverable code.

plugins.name: second-opinion
plugins.description: Teaches Claude to consult other AI coding CLIs (Gemini, OpenAI Codex, Grok, Aider, Warp, vibe-tools) non-interactively to get an independent second opinion on a question, design, review, or bug, then synthesize their input.
